description_en: Adds a commit status record for a specified commit
description_zh: 给指定的Commit添加一条提交状态记录
name: CreateCommitStatus

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can find the organization ID in your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example, https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en:
The personal access token.
This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) temporary token for authentication
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en:
A string identifier to differentiate statuses from different systems. The UI displays it as a title. The default value is "default". The maximum length is 50 characters, and the value is case-insensitive.

This parameter is crucial for configuring quality gates and merge request integrations. Do not change it unless you are testing or debugging
parameters.help_zh:
用于区分不同系统写入的字符串标识，会以标题的作用在相应的页面UI处进行展示，默认为default，长度不超过50，且英文大小写不敏感

该参数在设置卡点和合并请求联动中非常重要，若非测试调试，切勿随意设置
parameters.name: context

parameters.help_en: A short description of the commit status. The description cannot exceed 3,000 characters
parameters.help_zh: 提交状态的简要描述，且不能超过3000个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The state of the commit status. The API returns an error if you provide any value other than the following:

error

failure

pending

success
parameters.help_zh:
写入状态，且仅能填入以下四个字符串，否则会返回错误。
error：异常
failure：失败
pending：运行中
success：成功
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: A URL to associate with this status. The UI links to this URL, which typically points to a third-party system
parameters.help_zh: 用户自行写入的跳转链接，代码平台仅提供跳转的UI，一般可设置为三方系统的链接
parameters.name: target_url

context.description_en: A string identifier to differentiate statuses from different systems. The UI displays it as a title. The default value is "default". The maximum length is 50 characters, and the value is case-insensitive
context.description_zh: 用于区分不同系统写入的字符串标识，会以标题的作用在相应的页面UI处进行展示，默认为default，长度不超过50，且英文大小写不敏感

creator.description_en: Information about the user or application that created the commit status
creator.description_zh: 提交状态的写入人简要信息

aliyunPk.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. This field is empty if "type" is "Bot"
aliyunPk.description_zh: 阿里云账号ID，若type=Bot时，则为空

login.description_en: If "type" is "User", this is the username. If "type" is "Bot", this is the application name
login.description_zh: 若type=User，则为用户名；若type=Bot，则为应用名

type.description_en:
The type of creator.

"User": A regular user.

"Bot": An application
type.description_zh:
写入人类型
User：普通用户类型
Bot：应用类型

description.description_en: A short description of the commit status. The description cannot exceed 3,000 characters
description.description_zh: 提交状态的简要描述，且不能超过3000个字符

id.description_en: The unique ID of the commit status record. This ID has no business significance

state.description_en:
The state of the commit status.

error

failure

pending

success
state.description_zh:
写入状态
error：异常
failure：失败
pending：运行中
success：成功

targetUrl.description_en: A URL to associate with this status. The UI links to this URL, which typically points to a third-party system
targetUrl.description_zh: 用户自行写入的跳转链接，代码平台仅提供跳转的UI，一般可设置为三方系统的链接

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful
